responses.text: {Angry drill sergeant} Who the hell are you, coming in here and asking me if I can "spare any?" I don't hand out NCR troopers to anybody who wanders out of the Wasteland!
{Gruff but pleased} Hey, you're a damn fine soldier, and word on the grapevine is that you're already some kind of hero. You got yourself a deal.
{Gruff but pleased} After what you did getting my misfits whipped into shape? Yeah, I can spare a couple of boys for Bitter Springs. I'll issue the dispatch orders.

topics.prompt: Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?

responses.text: Hell of a thing about Chief Hanlon. I never would have guessed he was capable of it.
I've been hearing some rumors from the Embassy that Mr. House has gone quiet all of a sudden. You wouldn't know anything about that, would you?
Nice work dealing with Caesar. That'll make holding the Mojave a lot easier.
Have you seen these elite rangers they sent us from California? God damn those boys are gonna kick some ass!
Nice work with that assassination attempt! If my troops were half as dedicated as you, we'd win the war in a week!
Looks like the President's security detail was too good for you, huh, shitbird?
You oughta die for what you did.
Not like I even voted for him, but losing the President's a hell of a morale killer.
I just got word that 1st Recon is being mobilized to Nelson. God forbid we get any reinforcements here, right?
Seems the Misfits scored pretty well on their readiness evaluations. That strikes me as... suspicious.
I gotta admit, I'm impressed. The Misfits are drilling better than I ever expected.
I'm not sure what's going on with the Misfits - their accuracy is in the toilet, but they're spoiling for a fight like I ain't never seen.
Well, their test scores are only marginally improved, but I'm hearing good things about the Misfits' teamwork.
Ah, hell, what is it now?
{Pleased to see the player} What can I do for you?
You here to help, or just dick around all day?
{Very pleased to see the player} Hot damn, look who it is!
{Frazzled and annoyed} Oh, great, like I don't have enough problems!
{Cold} What the hell do you want?
What the hell do you want, you vicious son of a bitch?
What the hell do you want, you vicious bitch?
So you're back. What else do you want?
Man, it's my life. I joined up when I was 16 - I don't know how to do anything else.

topics.prompt: How do you like serving in the Army?

responses.text: I've been here since the first push into Vegas. Back in the day, this camp was the hotspot for conflicts with the Legion, raider tribes, you name it.
These days, I spend most of my time trying to beat a little discipline into the soldiers under my command. They've gotten soft with no action.

topics.prompt: How'd you end up at Camp Golf?

responses.text: Disappointed? We call 'em the Misfits for a reason. They're undisciplined, lazy, and they have absolutely no espirit de corps.
The squad leader's got some promise, kid named Mags, but as for the rest...{Trails off} I don't see much hope.
I'm going to make them shape up if it kills me, though. Or them, for that matter.

topics.prompt: Sounds like you're a little disappointed in your troops.

responses.text: Yeah, well... I didn't want to get promoted out of the field. I didn't join up to drive a desk.

topics.prompt: You joined at 16 and you're still a sergeant?

responses.text: Thanks. I only wish some of the soldiers under my command would share some of it.
Yeah, well, somebody has to wrangle those washouts and losers. Somebody's got to turn them into a real fighting force.

topics.prompt: Funny, I thought this was where they sent washouts and losers.

responses.text: Mostly drill the troops, try to keep the discipline up and combat readiness high.
It's not the easiest job in the world - soldiers without a mission get bored very easily.
Still, with the Legion just across the river, we have to be ready.

topics.prompt: So what do you do now that the fighting's died down?

responses.text: You're welcome to try - hell, maybe they'll listen to somebody they don't see as an authority figure.

topics.prompt: Maybe I can help you whip them into shape.

responses.text: I'd be skeptical of the odds, myself. I just hope they figure it out before it comes to that.

topics.prompt: Tough luck. If the Legion attacks, they're dead meat.

responses.text: I suppose so. Sorry, this isn't your problem, I shouldn't be going on to you about this.

topics.prompt: If they don't, it's their loss.

responses.text: {Irritated, busy} Yeah, whatever.
